About Headstart and our diversity recruitment software | Headstart
We’re on a mission to make recruiting fair.
It’s no longer enough to improve diversity. Businesses must actively fight discrimination in their hiring processes, because it’s the right thing to do.
Headstart is applicant matching and management software for early talent teams. Our customers lead the way in fair recruiting, hiring diverse future leaders to improve business performance.

Since launching in 2016, we’ve disrupted the recruitment industry with the idea that ‘people are more than a piece of paper’. We believe in contextualising data to change the way organisations think about people and talent.
We’re using technology to change the way businesses hire to maximize their success.
We use machine learning and dat science to transform the recruiting process, enabling clients to find the right high potential employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or age.
With major brands publicly supporting our mission, Headstart is fighting discrimination and enabling opportunity for candidates all around the world.

We are a small, perfectly formed team taking on an almost impossible vision. We are a fully transparent and open business, and we try and engage everyone from across the business in all key decisions and actions, regardless of whether you are in product, operations, sales, or customer success.

We believe people work at their best when they feel their best, both mentally and physically, so we believe in the importance of giving people autonomy and responsibility to deliver in a way that allows them to deliver their best personal and professional selves.

We believe that the technology of today allows every individual to contribute to building a great business without having to waste precious hours on a depressing commute or being forced to work in an homogenised environment.
Headstart Nursery – Headstart Nursery

This aerial drone video shows greenhouses and outdoor growing areas at Headstart Nursery’s Desert Sea facility in the Coachella Valley. By shifting plants between our desert and Northern California locations, we can grow superior plants for all our customers at any time of year.
Why Start with Headstart?

Our customers know they can rely on our 40+ years of experience and expertise to consistently produce top quality transplants and plugs that are compact, well-rooted, and ready to grow. We specialize in diﬃcult-to-grow crops and organically grown transplants.

With nearly 3 million square feet of greenhouse and outdoor growing space at our facilities in Gilroy, Salinas, Castroville, and the Coachella Valley, Headstart Nursery can provide an ideal growing environment at any time of the year.

At Headstart Nursery, we don’t just grow great plants—we also provide great service. Whether you’re ordering a million plants or just a single tray, we pride ourselves on being friendly, ﬂexible, and responsive.
with Headstart Nursery?
At Headstart Nursery, we are committed to providing our customers with top quality plants and service. If you ever have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Contact Us – Headstart Nursery
info@HeadstartNursery.com

Headstart Nursery’s main facility and company headquarters are in Gilroy, California, just 25 miles north of Salinas. Gilroy’s warm summers, cool nights, and high light intensity make it an ideal climate to grow transplants year-round for the San Joaquin and Salinas Valleys.

With greenhouses and outdoor growing areas in the Coachella Valley, we can take advantage of the desert’s high light and warm temperatures in the winter months and provide desert-hardened plants and superior service to growers throughout Southern California and Arizona.

Headstart Nursery’s facilities in Castroville provide a third climate zone, with coastal fog and cooler summer temperatures, enabling us to provide top quality plants year-round. In addition to vegetable transplants, we also grow poinsettias, cyclamen, gerbera, and other ornamental crops in Castroville.
